title: Letter Sounds
introduction: Learn about letter sounds through simple examples and practice.
definition: Letters represent sounds. In simple words, m often represents /m/ and s often represents /s/.
rules: Say the first sound in a word, not just the letter name.
Listen to a grown-up say the words slowly.

vocabulary.description: The bright object in the daytime sky.
A picture showing where places are.

examples.question: Which letter begins sun?
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.
